categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: international dry bulk shipping and department store retail. The shipping segment involves operating a fleet of 11 bulk carriers transporting commodities like grains, ores, and coal globally. The retail segment, mainly through its subsidiary in China, operates department stores selling apparel, jewelry, cosmetics, and other consumer goods, complemented by dining and entertainment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: In shipping, the company employs modern ship management practices including electronic ship management to improve maintenance efficiency and reduce costs. The fleet consists of relatively young vessels equipped with environmentally friendly engines and pollution control systems. The retail segment focuses on digital integration, utilizing big data and AI for customer behavior analysis and precision marketing, alongside online-offline retail channel integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shipping customers are primarily commodity producers and traders requiring bulk transport services worldwide, including major importers of iron ore, coal, and grains. The retail segment targets general consumers in first to third-tier Chinese cities, focusing on fashion-conscious and quality-seeking shoppers, with an emphasis on millennials and younger demographics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The shipping business operates globally, serving major safe ports worldwide with vessels registered mainly in Panama and Liberia. The retail business is concentrated in China, with stores located in major urban centers such as Shanghai, Wuhan, Fuzhou, and other key cities across first to third-tier markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: In shipping, the company operates midstream as a shipowner and operator providing transportation services between commodity producers and end users. In retail, it functions downstream as a retailer leasing commercial space and selling products sourced from upstream brand suppliers and distributors to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on fleet modernization, cost control, and compliance with upcoming environmental regulations in shipping. It emphasizes talent development and digital transformation in retail, including enhancing online sales channels, precision membership management using AI and big data, and upgrading store formats to improve customer experience and market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through chartering and freight services in the shipping segment, including time charters, voyage charters, and pool operations. The retail segment earns revenue from direct sales of merchandise, concessionaire commissions, rental income from leased retail spaces, and management consulting fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In shipping, the company competes with global dry bulk operators but holds a relatively small market share due to fleet size. It differentiates by operating a modern, efficient fleet and flexible chartering strategies. In retail, it competes with other department stores and shopping centers in China, leveraging prime locations, brand mix optimization, and digital integration to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The consolidated revenue declined from approximately NT$5.5 billion in 2023 to NT$4.85 billion in 2024, reflecting an 11.85% decrease. The company reported a net loss attributable to the parent company of about NT$289 million in 2024, an improvement from a larger loss in 2023. The asset base is around NT$34.9 billion with stable equity. The company is focusing on cost control and operational efficiency to stabilize growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers stable, safe, and economical dry bulk shipping services with a modern fleet tailored to diverse cargo and port requirements. In retail, it emphasizes a customer-centric approach with integrated online and offline shopping experiences, enriched brand portfolios, and enhanced experiential retail formats to meet evolving consumer preferences and increase loyalty.
